title: Variable Fractional Delay
text: 按随时间变化的分数采样周期数延迟输入，输入 2 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Interpolation mode} 指定插值方法；{Interpolation filter half-length (P)} 指定插值滤波器的半长、{Interpolation points per input sample} 指定每个输入采样的插值点数、{Normalized input bandwidth (0 to 1)} 指定归一化输入带宽、{Farrow filter length (N)} 指定 Farrow 滤波器长度、{Maximum delay (Dmax) in samples} 指定最大延迟、{Input processing} 指定处理输入的方法 Columns、{InitialConditions} 指定内存中的初始值、{Disable direct feedthrough by increasing minimum possible delay by one} 指定禁用直接馈通、{For small input delay values} 指定输入延迟值较小时要采取的操作 Clip to the minimum value necessary、{Valid delay range (in samples)} 指定有效延迟值的范围 Read-only、{Rounding mode} 指定定点运算的舍入方法、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出操作的方法、{Coefficients} 指定系数的数据类型 Same word length、{Product output} 指定乘积输出的数据类型 Same as first、{Accumulator} 指定累加运算的数据类型 Same as product、{Product output polyval} 指定乘积多项式值的数据类型 Same as first、{Accumulator polyval} 指定累加器多项式值的数据类型 Same as first、{Multiplicand polyval} 指定被乘数多项式值的数据类型 Same as first、{Output} 指定模块输出的数据类型 Same、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Delay
ports.summary: 延迟输入 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Interpolation mode
params.values: 插值方法 Linear (default) | FIR | Farrow

params.name: Interpolation filter half-length (P)
params.values: 插值滤波器的半长 4 (default) | positive integer in the range [1 65535]

params.name: Interpolation points per input sample
params.values: 每个输入采样的插值点数 10 (default) | positive integer in the range [2, 65,535]

params.name: Normalized input bandwidth (0 to 1)
params.values: 归一化输入带宽 1 (default) | real scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: Farrow filter length (N)
params.values: Farrow 滤波器长度 4 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Maximum delay (Dmax) in samples
params.values: 最大延迟 100 (default) | integer in the range [0 65535]

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 处理输入的方法 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: InitialConditions
params.values: 内存中的初始值 0 (default) | scalar | 1-by- R -by- D array | 1-by- R -by-( D+L ) array

params.name: Disable direct feedthrough by increasing minimum possible delay by one
params.values: 禁用直接馈通 off (default) | on

params.name: For small input delay values
params.values: 输入延迟值较小时要采取的操作 Clip to the minimum value necessary for centered kernel (default) | Use off-centered kernel | Switch to linear interpolation if kernel cannot be centered

params.name: Valid delay range (in samples)
params.values: 有效延迟值的范围 Read-only: [0 100] (default) | [ D min D max ]

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 定点运算的舍入方法 Zero (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Floor | Nearest | Round | Simplest

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: 系数的数据类型 Same word length as input (default) | Specify word length

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出的数据类型 Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加运算的数据类型 Same as product output (default) | Same as first input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Product output polyval
params.values: 乘积多项式值的数据类型 Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator polyval
params.values: 累加器多项式值的数据类型 Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Multiplicand polyval
params.values: 被乘数多项式值的数据类型 Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Output
params.values: 模块输出的数据类型 Same as accumulator (default) | Same as first input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
